scripts.build: npm run check:build-inputs && tar -xzf public/careerdev-global-assets.tgz -C public && next build
scripts.verify:phase1: npm run audit:source && npm run typecheck && npm run check:build-inputs && npm run validate:auth-manifest
scripts.verify:phase2: npm run verify:phase1 && npm run validate:phase2-boundaries && npm run validate:edge-security
scripts.verify:phase3: npm run verify:phase2 && npm run validate:phase3-preview
scripts.verify:phase4: npm run verify:phase3 && npm run validate:phase4-simulation
scripts.test:ai-billing: node --test tests/ai-billing-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/ai-billing-webhook-source.test.mjs tests/ai-subscription-source.test.mjs tests/ai-credit-runtime.test.mjs tests/ai-payment-adjustments.test.mjs tests/ai-webhook-delivery-probe.test.mjs tests/ai-credit-idempotency-binding.test.mjs
